notes.title: Chibi Reboot Patch 1.06 - BUGFIX
notes.notes:
Chibi Reboot Patch 1.06 - BUGFIX

A small bugfix patch that fixes errors in the German version.


 The general speed of the bat opponents has been reduced.
 The ‘Spike’ item was not executed correctly in the German version and you got stuck on an opponent. Has now been fixed.
 Stages 1-4 have been widened a little so that you are no longer trapped by the field mice.
 Stage 3-4, the number of enemies has been reduced.


Have fun with Chibi Reboot. If you have discovered a mistake, please let me know!
